meta.name: liger-kernel-perf
meta.description: Optimizes the performance of existing Liger Kernel Triton kernels. Profiles kernels, diagnoses bottlenecks (memory-bound vs compute-bound), generates multiple optimization variants with benchmarking, and applies the best variant while maintaining correctness. Supports GPU architecture-specific optimization (Ampere, Hopper, Blackwell). Use when a user asks to optimize, speed up, tune, profile, or reduce memory of an existing Liger kernel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动剖析并优化 Triton 内核，突破 GPU 性能瓶颈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Triton 编写 GPU 内核并想榨干硬件性能。
copy.tagline_en: Profile and optimize Triton kernels automatically to boost GPU performance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Triton kernels and want to maximize hardware utilization.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先剖析 Liger Kernel 内核的性能瓶颈,再生成多个优化版本并逐一测试,最后把通过校验的优胜版本写回原代码,并给出前后对比报告。仅支持 NVIDIA GPU。
howto.when: 当你说要优化、加速或减少现有 Liger Kernel 内核的内存占用时触发;说“just optimize it”等则会自动完成全部步骤。

say.text: 帮我优化 rms_norm 这个 Liger kernel,目标是速度优先。
say.note: 会进入性能剖析与瓶颈诊断。

say.text: 用自动模式优化 cross_entropy,不用中途问我。
say.note: 会无中断跑完三个阶段。

say.text: 给 attention 内核调优,目标 GPU 是 Hopper。
say.note: 会按 Hopper 架构做专项优化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will profile existing Liger Kernel kernels, diagnose bottlenecks, generate multiple optimized variants with benchmarking, and apply the winning variant that passes validation back to the source, providing a before/after report. NVIDIA GPUs only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to optimize, speed up, or reduce memory of an existing Liger Kernel. Saying 'just optimize it' etc. runs all stages automatically.

say_en.text: Optimize the rms_norm Liger kernel with speed as the priority.
say_en.note: Starts with profiling and bottleneck diagnosis.

say_en.text: Optimize cross_entropy in autonomous mode; don't ask me in between.
say_en.note: Runs all three stages end-to-end automatically.

say_en.text: Tune the attention kernel for the Hopper GPU.
